[build-system]
requires = [
    "hatchling",
]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [
    "src/tex2pdf",
]

[tool.uv]
package = false
constraint-dependencies = [
    "idna==3.19",
    "gitpython==3.1.59",
    "pyarrow==25.0.1",
    "pip==26.2.1",
    "msgpack==1.2.1",
]

[tool.uv.workspace]
members = [
    "src/api",
    "src/cli",
    "src/core",
]

[tool.uv.sources.bizlog]
path = "../../03-shared-services/bizlog"

[tool.mypy]
plugins = [
    "pydantic.mypy",
]
explicit_package_bases = true
python_version = "3.12"
strict = true
pretty = true
show_error_codes = true
